set_pixels.name: Set bulb colours
set_pixels.description: Colour every bulb at once, starting at the plug.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: List of colours, one per bulb, as "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b].

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Repeat the list along the whole string.

play_sequence.name: Play sequence
play_sequence.description: Play an xLights .fseq file on every string, without xLights running.

file.name: Sequence file
file.description: Path to the .fseq file. Relative names are looked up in /media/xlights, then /config/www/xlights.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Start again from the beginning when the sequence ends. With a speaker, the speaker's repeat setting decides instead.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: Media player (e.g. a Music Assistant player) to play the music on. The lights follow its playback position, pause when it pauses and stop when it stops or changes song.

audio.name: Audio
audio.description: What to play on the speaker: any media content ID it accepts, e.g. a Music Assistant URI (library://track/…, spotify://track/…), a URL or a media-source:// ID.

audio_offset.name: Offset
audio_offset.description: Seconds to shift the lights later (positive) or earlier (negative), to fine-tune for speaker lag. Without a speaker, a delay before the lights start.

stop_sequence.name: Stop sequence
stop_sequence.description: Stop the playing sequence and turn the bulbs dark.

set_pattern.name: Set pattern
set_pattern.description: Pick the bulbs' colour pattern, how it moves, and the speed. Speed on its own changes the speed of whatever effect is running.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Which colours the bulbs show, repeated along the string.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: How the pattern moves: Steady, Twinkle, Chase and more.

start_zone.name: Start zone
start_zone.description: Show a pattern across the runs of a zone (set up in the Light Shows app, Map tab) as one thing, in sync. Give a zone, or an area to use every run in it without a saved zone. A zone keeps its lights until you pick a colour or effect on one, turn it off, or a show starts.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone's name or id. Give this or an area.

area.name: Area
area.description: An area's name or id: the pattern runs across every run in that area (nothing is saved). Give this or a zone.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Which colours to show. Kept as the zone's pattern.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: How the pattern moves. Kept as the zone's effect.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 1 (slow) to 100 (fast); 50 is normal. Kept as the zone's speed.

stop_zone.name: Stop zone
stop_zone.description: Stop a zone. Its lights go back to what they showed before, or turn off if the zone turned them on.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone's name or id. Give this or an area.

area.name: Area
area.description: An area whose pattern was started with the area field.
